_doc: Task 53 restricted places + the day guards (scripts/systems/staff_posts.gd, restricted_places.gd). posts.<venue type>: staff who stand at a post while the place is open, worked out from the building's front door: `depth` tiles in from the door, `side` tiles to the left (-) or right (+) of the walk in. guard: a security guard (stops or escorts people). hours: only then (the market's busy hours). These add to the posts a template already has. public_depth: how far in from the front door the public part of the building goes; past that (or on any upper floor) is staff only, unless you work there. The bank is not a building on the map yet, so it has no post.

stop: "Sorry, you can't be back here," says {n}.
{n} steps into your way. "Staff only past this point."
"Can I help you?" {n} asks, in a voice that means turn around.
escort: {n} takes you by the elbow and walks you back out the front door.
{n} walks you out without another word.
call: {n} picks up the phone, watching you.
turn_back: You head back the way you came.
